faq: Is Umanga a registered migration agent?
Yes. Umanga Nadisha Oberoi's MARN is 0850042, first registered in 2008. You can check it on the official OMARA register.
Do you help with study outside Australia?
Yes. OBCO helps students with study options in Australia, New Zealand and Canada.
